programme.title: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Thackray Medical Museum
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters investigate Thackray Medical Museum, believed to one of Leeds most haunted buildings. Workers claim to have witnessed constant paranormal activity in the museum and one claim is that two Victorian ghosts are trapped...

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en anal sondeundersøgelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer, at han har et nærgående møde med et rumvæsen. De andre drenge er overbeviste om, at drømmen var virkelig, og at han har været offer for en anal sondeundersøgelse af et rumvæsen.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største nar
programme.desc: Da et berømt spititistik medium ikke kan mane Kenny ud af Cartmans krop, forsøger Chefs mor lidt voodoomagi på ham selv.

programme.title: South Park: Chef-hjælp
programme.desc: Chef prøver at opkræve afgifter fra et pladeselskab, da de lancerer en sang, han hævder, at han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Øjenbetændelse
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny bliver slået ihjel af en nedfaldende rumstation og bliver forvandlet til en zombie af noget balsamerende væske, der er forurenet med engelsk sovs.

programme.title: South Park: De bedste venner i verden
programme.desc: Cartman bliver jaloux, da Kenny får den sidste bærbare spilkonsol, før legetøjsforretningen løber tør. Vil Cartman og Kenny forblive bedste venner for evigt?

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dør
programme.desc: Kenny bliver dødeligt syg, og stakkels Stan har svært ved at klare det.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tager sin nye kæreste med til en Jonas Brothers-koncert, hvor de får kyskhedsringe.

programme.title: South Park: Surt for Cartman
programme.desc: Butters bliver sendt til en speciel lejr for 'Pray the Gay Away', efter han er blevet grebet i en kompromitterende situation med Cartman. Cartman prøver at få fat i et billede af situationen.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle inviterer Butters i stedet for Cartman til sin fødselsdagsfest, så Cartman bilder Butters ind, at en meteor vil ramme jorden og lukker ham inde i et beskyttelsesrum, så han selv kan gå i stedet.

programme.title: South Park: Sjov med våben
programme.desc: Drengene køber kampsportsvåben på et loppemarked og forvandles til japanske tegnefilmskrigere. Det får hårde konsekvenser for stakkels Butters.

programme.title: South Park: Den sidste meehicaner
programme.desc: Da et spil 'grænsekontrol' går galt antænder Butters mexicansk stolthed, men Cartman er ikke villig til at holde op, mens legen stadig er god.

programme.title: South Park: Butterballs
programme.desc: Butters bliver mobbet af sin bedstemor, og Stan vil skabe opmærksomhed om problemet ved at indspille en video, men dens succes stiger ham snart til hovedet.

programme.title: South Park: Historien om Scrotie McBoogerballs
programme.desc: Butters får skylden - og derefter æren - efter drengene skriver en bog, som skulle være vildt grov, men som bliver hyldet som et mesterværk.

programme.title: South Park: Frizone
programme.desc: Cartman bliver offer for body-shaming.

programme.title: South Park: Ikes diller
programme.desc: Kyle prøver at redde sin lillebrors penis fra at blive skåret af.

programme.title: South Park: Chef går bananas
programme.desc: Chef erklærer, at South Parks flag er racistisk. Stan og Kyle leder den gruppe, der støtter det nuværende flag, mens Wendy og Cartman slutter sig til dem, som går ind for et nyt flag.

programme.title: South Park: Det skøre mishandlingseventyr
programme.desc: Kyle melder sine forældre til politiet for 'mishandling'. Snart anmelder alle børn deres forældre, indtil der kun er børn tilbage i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet om de to urinaler
programme.desc: Cartman tror, han ved, hvem der stod bag angrebene den 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 1
programme.desc: Drengene befinder sig i et magisk land, hvor hele verdens fantasi ligger lige foran dem. Men en terrorplan truer med at ødelægge det hele.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 2
programme.desc: Regeringen holder Stan og Kyle i fangenskab og vil ikke frigive dem, før de afslører, hvordan de kom ind i Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 3
programme.desc: Stan og Butters er strandet i Imaginationland og må kæmpe for livet mod en hær af onde kræfter. Kyle og Cartman er stadig i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: Det bryder løs
programme.desc: 'Du ved hvad' bryder løs, da indbyggerne i South Park hører ordet '****' i det populære show 'Cop Drama'.

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Stan får en Okama Gamesphere, og drengene er fascinerede af den. Mens de spiller, kommer et talende håndklæde ved navn Towelie og taler med dem.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos
programme.desc: Drengene fyrer Butters som deres ven, og vækker hans mørke side.

programme.title: South Park: Børnekidnapning er ikke sjovt
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at beskytte deres børn fra kidnappere, hyrer forældrene ejeren af City Wok for at bygge den Kinesiske Mur i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Grå daggry
programme.desc: De ældre indbyggere bliver tvunget til at indlevere deres kørekort efter at have forårsaget kaos i gaderne. Stans bedstefar tilkalder AARP for at hjælpe pensionisterne.

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: South Park er invaderet af arbejdere fra fremtiden, som tager alle job for en lavere betaling. Mændene i South Park griber til usædvanlige midler for at standse dem.

programme.title: South Park: Wall-Mart er på vej
programme.desc: Da Wall-Mart forvandler South Park til en spøgelsesby, prøver Stan og Kyle at ødelægge forretningen, men en besat Cartman står dem i vejen.

programme.title: South Park: Kinaproblemer
programme.desc: Foruroliget af de olympiske ceremoniers storhed, beder Cartmann Butters om hjælp til at konfrontere kineserne. Samtidig er Stan og Kyle vidne til 'voldtægten' af Indianan Jones.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tager sin nye kæreste med til en Jonas Brothers-koncert, hvor de får kyskhedsringe.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskefingre
programme.desc: Jimmy er vred over, at Cartman prøver at tage æren for en joke, som han fandt på, der nu er blevet populær i hele landet. Men en vred Kanye West kan ikke forstå pointen.

programme.title: South Park: Døde kendisser
programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøgelse nægter at acceptere sin hedengang og efterlader resten af de nylig afdøde berømtheder frustrerede i Skærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Seksuel healing
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinder sig midt blandt Amerikas superkendisser, når de bliver behandlet for sexafhængighed. Cartman og Stan er klistret til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: South Park: Funnybot
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet gjort grin med til skolens komedie-aften, bygger Tyskland den ultimative grinemaskine: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheden bliver ikke godt modtaget.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman finder kærligheden
programme.desc: Cartman leger ægteskabsmægler, da en ny pige flytter til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Højere standard
programme.desc: Cartman indrømmer endelig, at han er fed, og anskaffer sig en el-scooter.

programme.title: South Park: Læg den væk
programme.desc: Nordkorea har South Park i sigtekornet.

programme.title: South Park: Hummel-figurer & heroin
programme.desc: Elskede entertainere dør i deres bedste levetid på grund af overdoser. Stan er ved at blive afsløret som kilden til de ulovlige stoffer.

programme.title: South Park: Band i Kina
programme.desc: Randy ser en mulighed for Tegridy i Kina.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle bliver uvenner over en magisk trekant, som dukker op på en arkæologisk udgravning. Trekanten giver magt til at forandre Barbra Streisand til et forfærdeligt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Chefs salte chokoladekugler
programme.desc: Da Chef ikke kan sælge sine karameller ved en besøgende filmfestival, ændrer han sin opskrift til salte chokoladekugler og digter en sang, som skal hjælpe ham med at sælge dem.

programme.title: South Park: Chef-hjælp
programme.desc: Chef prøver at opkræve afgifter fra et pladeselskab, da de lancerer en sang, han hævder, at han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Regnskov dropskov
programme.desc: Drengene bliver sendt til regnskoven i Costa Rica som led i en turné med koret Getting Gay With Kids.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny biver fanget af den nyeste dille fra Japan, Chinpokomon.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Efter Cady har boet i Afrika, aner hun intet om, hvor 'vilde' ting kan blive i civilisationen, indtil hun møder den ondeste art 'Queen Bee', der på denne skole er den kølige og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: Boys And Girls
programme.desc: Ryan (Freddie Prinze, Jr.) og Jennifer (Claire Forlani) kunne ikke være mere forskellige. Som børn hadede de hinanden. Som voksne binder deres forskelle dem sammen i denne sjove RomCom fra instruktøren bag SHE'S ALL THAT.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: Præsidentkandidaten
programme.desc: En mand slutter sig til den politiske kampagne for en snu kandidat til præsident i USA.

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårdtarbejdende mor tager sine børn med på et udfordrende road trip efter hendes mands svigt.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-ekspert Friar finder en bombe spændt fast til sin skrivebordsstol, og en uset hacker beordrer ham til at stjæle digitale pengebeløb online – ellers vil hans datter blive bortført.

programme.title: Final Target
programme.desc: Ava er en dødsensfarlig lejesoldat, der har højprofilerede lejemord som speciale. Men en opgave går galt, og hendes arbejdsgivere sender i al hemmelighed en lejemorder efter hende...

programme.title: Også engle spiser bønner
programme.desc: Charlie er fribryder i forbudstidens New York, og han nægter at være med til at fikse en kamp, og gangsterbossen Angelo har satset penge på modstanderen. Han bliver nødt til at flygte, og under flugten støder han på Sonny, der også er på flugt.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: I'm Not There' er en svimlende tur gennem Bob Dylans mytologiske verden og omskiftelige liv. Seks forskellige skuespillere spiller seks forskellige sider af Dylan i hans mest frugtbare årtier alt sammen set og hørt igennem Dylans udødelige tekster.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ind i mellem
programme.desc: Da Jesses liv hænger på en tynd tråd, må Brennan skabe forbindelse til ham og føre ham gennem tidligere minder, som de har delt, for at redde hans liv.

programme.title: Mutant X: Drømmeelsker
programme.desc: Mutant X skal forhindre en videnskabsmand i at klone kvinder til brug som slaver i sin ultraeksklusive mandeklub.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Ild i himlen
programme.desc: Mens Sydney holder foredrag om de indfødte amerikanere, der stod over for en mystisk katastrofe 600 år tidligere, bringer en indfødt hende et levn fra den tid. Hvad er dens hemmelighed?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: På jagt med fjenden
programme.desc: En urne, som den kinesiske kejser havde bestilt i et cambodjansk kloster til konfucius' jordiske rester, er ved at blive ødelagt af systematisk bombning af en hel provins.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the drug trade in New York City was a nightmare. Dealers made millions. Street violence was out of control. The NYPD battled the drug gangs only to become their target.

programme.title: The FBI Files: First and Kennedy Street Crew
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the streets of New York flooded with crack cocaine in the 1980's a wave of violence threatened to drown the city. Colombian cartels brought the coke in and ran their operations with an iron fist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Evil Intent
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.desc: Beavis møder en hemmelig beundrer i skolen./ Beavis and Butt-Head krydser tidslinjen på en udflugt og tror, de kan rejse i tiden.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Pool Toys / Beavis & Butt-Head's Island

programme.title: RENO 911!: Execution Tickets
programme.desc: The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine's Pregnant
programme.desc: A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jones Gets Suspended
programme.desc: Jones enjoys some unexpected perks after being relegated to crossing guard duty, and Dangle's bike is stolen again.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Help From the FBI
programme.desc: While the FBI investigates a Reno homicide, members of the Sheriff's Department put their best feet forward.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel Suicide Watch
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department lavishes attention on Wiegel after her failed suicide attempt, and Williams and Garcia hook up.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine Gets Married
programme.desc: Clemmy's degenerate boyfriend Steed surprises everyone when he asks her to marry him.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Anniversary
programme.desc: The guys hit a strip club to celebrate Garcia's 15-year anniversary on the force.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Burning Man Festival
programme.desc: When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Day 1
programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. Aftenens gæstedommere er David Spade og Kevin Hart.

programme.title: The Roast of Flavor Flav
programme.desc: I hver udgave af 'The Roast of' bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Det er Flavor Flavs tur til at sætte sig i kendissernes varme stol i det nyeste afsnit af The Comedy Central Roast.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: Jeff Ross: Roasts The Border
programme.desc: I dette program, der er delvis stand-up og delvis dokumenter, gransker og dissekerer Jeff Ross USA'simmigrationsdebat.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: What You Need
programme.desc: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Four of Us are Dying
programme.desc: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Third From the Sun
programme.desc: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
programme.desc: Three astronauts crash on what they believe to be an asteroid. Unfortunately, they have only limited water supplies to sustain them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Hitch-Hiker
programme.desc: Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Fever
programme.desc: Tight-fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Flight
programme.desc: A World War I flying ace flies through a mysterious cloud - and lands at a modern U.S. airbase in the year 1959!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Purple Testament
programme.desc: Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.

programme.title: South Park: Freemium er ikke gratis
programme.desc: Stan er afhængig af det nye Terrance og Phillip-mobilspil.

programme.title: South Park: Heksesønner

programme.desc: Jack and Ryan recover a cursed antique and take it to the shop before leaving, but its owners come looking for it and Micki must fend for herself.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Scarecrow
programme.desc: One of the local farmers uses a cursed scarecrow. She must pin the pictures of three victims on the scarecrow's chest. When it claims all three victims, the result is a good harvest.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Harlan County Courthouse was both sanctuary and execution site. The town hub that witnessed a brutal revenge killing and countless trials of corrupt lawmen is the site of the country's most haunted building.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The screams of Cassius Clay in his final days can still be heard reverberating through the walls of White Hall. Caretakers have had their belief in the supernatural shifted ever since they began spending time at the site.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Brennans’ legacy begins and ends in their enchanting Old Louisville home: nearly every member of the Brennan clan perished within its walls or had their funeral service held here.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Equipped with new insight into the Kentucky Anomaly and a bevy of compiled evidence of paranormal phenomena, the team returns to the Conrad-Caldwell Museum.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tom Arnold, Dee Snider, Carnie Wilson, Nia Long
programme.desc: Tom Arnold takes his teenage anger out on a pipe organ, angering a revengeful spirit; Dee Snider's murdered brother-in-law has a message from the grave.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantændelse
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park eksploderer tilfældigt. Stans far er et af tilfældene.

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans gamle bedstefar forsøger at narre drengene til at slå ham ihjel. I mellemtiden forsøger South Parks forældre at overtale et tv-netværk til at befri luftrummet for Terrance og Philip.

programme.title: South Park: Cherokee hårtamponer
programme.desc: Kyle har brug for en nyretransplantation, og Cartman er den perfekte donor. Men Cartman sætter en høj pris på sin nyre: 10 millioner dollars.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingeelsker
programme.desc: Da Barbrady tilkalder drengene for at hjælpe med at opklare sagen om den berygtede kyllingeelsker, bliver Cartman begejstret for sin nyfundne 'authoritah'.

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himlen
programme.desc: Da drengene leder efter Kenny i Himlen, undersøger myndighederne om Saddam Hussein muligvis skjuler våben der.

programme.title: South Park: Det fattige barn
programme.desc: Kennys forældre bliver anholdt og han kommer i pleje - så nu er Cartman det fattigste barn på skolen! Og en mystisk, maskeret figur fra fortiden vender tilbage.

programme.title: South Park: Major Boobage
programme.desc: De hysteriske forældre i South Park får endnu en grund til at gå i panik, da 'cheesing' bliver populært blandt ungerne.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle bliver uvenner over en magisk trekant, som dukker op på en arkæologisk udgravning. Trekanten giver magt til at forandre Barbra Streisand til et forfærdeligt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Byens kerne
programme.desc: South Parks bykerne skal opgraderes og Kenny bestemmer sig for, at det er på tide at finde et job.

programme.title: South Park: Den ustuearrest-bare
programme.desc: Led og ked af hvordan han bliver behandlet af sine forældre, tager den altid uskyldige Butters den nye vampyr-galskab til sig, lidt for entusiastisk.

programme.title: South Park: Afleveringen af 'Ringenes Herre.'
programme.desc: Drengene tager på et mytisk eventyr for at aflevere deres kopi af 'Ringenes Herre' i videobutikken, og Butters ser sin første pornofilm.

programme.title: South Park: Butters' helt eget afsnit
programme.desc: Butter er tilbage med sin helt egen episode! Uforvarende kommer han til at afsløre en mørk familiehemmelighed om sin fars sene 'natteindkøbsture'.

programme.title: South Park: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om, at pigerne har et apparat, som kan se ind i fremtiden, så Butters klæder sig ud som pige for at infiltrere dem.

programme.title: South Park: Tilbage til rødderne
programme.desc: Butters begynder en rejse, der skal følge i sporene på hans hawaiianske forfædre.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos
programme.desc: Drengene fyrer Butters som deres ven, og vækker hans mørke side.

programme.title: South Park: Rosiner
programme.desc: Stan bliver kasseret af Wendy og bliver punker for at udleve smerten.

programme.title: South Park: City Sushi
programme.desc: Da Butters bliver indfanget i en asiatisk territoriestrid opdager hans forældre, at han har flere personligheder, og beslutter sig for, at løsningen er at medicinere ham.

programme.title: South Park: Margaritaville

programme.desc: Kyle melder sine forældre til politiet for 'mishandling'. Snart anmelder alle børn deres forældre, indtil der kun er børn tilbage i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemi
programme.desc: South Park bliver 'Cloverfield', da store, mystiske skabninger begynder at lave ravage rundt om på jorden, indfanget af Randys rystende webcamera.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemi 2: Chokket
programme.desc: Kæmpemarsvin angriber byer rundt om på jorden. Drengene har nøglen til at redde menneskeheden, men de sidder fast i Andesbjergene

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tager sin nye kæreste med til en Jonas Brothers-koncert, hvor de får kyskhedsringe.

programme.title: South Park: Fedskæg
programme.desc: Cartman har hørt om alle de rigdomme, der bliver plyndret af pirater i Somalien, så han tager klap for øjet og slæber slænget med til Afrika for at få en del af kagen.

programme.title: South Park: Tis
programme.desc: Høje urintal i svømmepølen fører til en katastrofe, der ødelægger drengenes dag, særligt Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får frit udløb igen.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Tilbageblik
programme.desc: Superhelten 'The Coon' er tilbage og denne gang har han venner!

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion rejser sig
programme.desc: Ført an af 'Mysterion', arbejder 'Coon' og hans venner med at hjælpe folk i Golfen. Og 'Coon' er ude efter hævn.

programme.title: South Park: Coon vs. Coon og venner
programme.desc: 'The Coon' viser sig at være endnu ondere end den mørke mester Cthulhu, når han kræver hævn over sine tidligere partnere.

programme.title: South Park: Funnybot
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet gjort grin med til skolens komedie-aften, bygger Tyskland den ultimative grinemaskine: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheden bliver ikke godt modtaget.

programme.title: South Park: Byen på kanten af for evigt (tilbageblik)
programme.desc: Skolebussen ender på kanten af en kløft efter at have forulykket i en snestorm.

programme.title: South Park: Chef-hjælp
programme.desc: Chef prøver at opkræve afgifter fra et pladeselskab, da de lancerer en sang, han hævder, at han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny biver fanget af den nyeste dille fra Japan, Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Cherokee hårtamponer
programme.desc: Kyle har brug for en nyretransplantation, og Cartman er den perfekte donor. Men Cartman sætter en høj pris på sin nyre: 10 millioner dollars.

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman skal dø
programme.desc: Cartman bliver tosset på Scott Tenorman, da den rødhårede Scott narrer vores eftergivende helt til at købe hans kønshår for 16.12 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer kvarteret
programme.desc: Som det eneste rige barn i byen, føler Token sig som et udskud, og detlykkes ham at tiltrække adskillige andre velhavende folk til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-trailer
programme.desc: Alle børnene i South Park er superspændte på at se den første trailer for den nye Terrance og Phillip-film.

programme.title: South Park: Krazy Kripples
programme.desc: Jimmy og Timmy tror, at en bande, der kaldes The Crips, er en klub for handicappede personer og bliver medlemmer.

programme.title: South Park: Fede røv og pandekagehoved
programme.desc: Cartman laver en J-lo-fingerdukke til et arrangement for kulturel mangfoldighed, der hylder latinamerikanere.

programme.title: South Park: Dø Hippie, Dø
programme.desc: Cartman bliver arresteret for at holde hippier indespærret, men da en bølge af hippier overtager South Park kommer byen til ham og hans uortodokse metoder til fjernelse af hippier.

programme.title: South Park: Vinge
programme.desc: Som talentagenter kan Cartman, Stan og Kenny indkassere 10 % af deres klienters fortjeneste. Men efter at have prøvet hårdt på at gøre indtryk på deres eneste klient, bliver han stjålet af en anden agent.

programme.title: South Park: Mere pis
programme.desc: Af vanvare slår Randy verdensrekorden for den 'største bæ'. Bono, den tidligere rekordindehaver, er besluttet på at fastholde kronen. Men han har en mørk hemmelighed, som kan standse ham.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Stan og Kyle er klar til det store gennembrud med deres evner på computerspillet Guitar Hero. Deres manager overbeviser Stan om, at Kyle holder ham tilbage, hvilket skaber spændinger.

programme.title: South Park: Grundskolemusical
programme.desc: Da musical-galskaben, hvor alle skal danse og synge, rammer South Park, må drengene gå med på den eller opgive deres popularitet.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tager sin nye kæreste med til en Jonas Brothers-koncert, hvor de får kyskhedsringe.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskefingre
programme.desc: Jimmy er vred over, at Cartman prøver at tage æren for en joke, som han fandt på, der nu er blevet populær i hele landet. Men en vred Kanye West kan ikke forstå pointen.

programme.title: South Park: Tis

programme.title: The Immigrant

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call - New Orleans
programme.desc: En korrupt betjent i New Orleans efterforsker en række brutale forbrydelser og kæmper samtidig med sin egen spiral af afhængighed og moralsk forfald.

programme.title: Slow West
programme.desc: En ung skotte rejser gennem det vilde vesten for at finde sin tabte kærlighed. Han allierer sig med en mystisk fremmed på en farefuld færd.

programme.title: A Bronx Tale
programme.desc: En ung fyr har vundet den lokale mafiaboss' gunst. Det giver mange fordele, men huer ikke hans far, der er en hæderlig buschauffør. Tingene bliver ikke nemmere, da fyren forelsker sig i en sort pige samtidig med, at der opstår konflikter mellem nogle…

programme.title: A Haunted House

programme.title: Demonia

programme.title: South Park: Damien

programme.title: South Park: Den uhyggelige fisk

programme.title: South Park: Succubus

programme.title: South Park: Wall-Mart er på vej

programme.title: South Park: Infårtion

programme.title: South Park: Goth Kids 3: Posørernes dag

programme.title: Fredag den 13. - Del V: Det begynder igen

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy

programme.title: The Stepford Wives

programme.title: South Park: Freemium er ikke gratis

programme.title: South Park: Heksesønner
programme.desc: På den årlige Halloween-sammenkomsten, kaster en heks trolldom som terroriserer alle i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Råtne tomater
programme.desc: Barna i South Park påstår at de har sett mr. Garrison luske rundt i byen. Folk i byen er sinte fordi presidenten skremmer barna deres.

programme.title: South Park: Sparkesyklene
programme.desc: Ungene planlegger å bruke siste nytt innen forflytning for å skaffe seg mer godteri til halloween enn de har fått noen gang.

programme.title: South Park: Tegridy Farms Halloween Special
programme.desc: Det er Halloween og Randy må forholde seg til datterens marihuanaproblem.

programme.title: South Park: Øyekatarr
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny blir drept av en styrtende romstasjon og forvandlet til en zombie, ved hjelp av balsameringsvæske og Worcestersaus.

programme.title: South Park: Universets største drittsekk
programme.desc: Cartman føler seg ikke bra etter å ha drukket Kennys aske og blitt besatt av sjelen hans, og sendes til sykehuset.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Etterpåklokskap

programme.title: South Park: Døden
programme.desc: Stans bestefar prøver å lure guttene til å drepe ham. Foreldrene i South Park prøver å få stanset sendingene av 'Terrance and Phillip'.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingelskeren

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en analundersøkelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer at han møter et romvesen, men de andre guttene er sikre på at drømmen var virkelighet.

programme.title: South Park: Kassebilderby

programme.title: South Park: Rumpeburgere

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno

programme.title: South Park: Penger og gull

programme.title: South Park: Asspen

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Long before the first funeral home was established in Manchester, Kentucky in 1938, there was the Chestnut House. The Chestnut family dedicated one of the home’s parlors to store the caskets they made.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Paranormal enthusiasts have theorized that Somerset County’s enthralling paranormal finds may have more to do with the geomagnetic anomalies present in its unique land that yield results which are fascinating to some and terrifying to others.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvete Promo
programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Roddy Piper
programme.desc: "Rowdy" Roddy Piper (legendary WWE wrestler) is paid a visit by Kim at his home in Portland, Oregon as he seeks answers to the ghost experiences.

programme.title: The Haunting Of. . .: Giancarlo Esposito
programme.desc: Giancarlo Esposito (Breaking Bad / Revolution / The Usual Suspects) tells the story of his former home in Ridgefield, CT.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans mor er en hore
programme.desc: Dr. Mephisto hjelper Cartman med å avsløre farens identitet, og alle mannlige innbyggere i South Park er aktuelle kandidater.

programme.title: South Park: Byen ved avgrunnens rand (tilbakeblikk)
programme.desc: Skolebussen krasjer i en snøstorm og blir stående på kanten av et stup.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef prøver å kreve royalties da et plateselskap slipper en låt han hevder han skrev for over 20 år siden.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Cartman og Kenny blir oppslukt av det siste nye fra Japan: Chinpokomon.

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer nabolaget
programme.desc: Token føler seg ensom fordi han er eneste rike barn i byen, og lokker andre velstående mennesker til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmtraileren
programme.desc: Alle barna i South Park er superspente på å se den første traileren for den nye Terrance og Phillip-filmen.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskepikker
programme.desc: Jimmi er rasende for at Cartmann prøver å ta æren for en vits som han fant på og som nå er blitt populær i hele landet. Men en sint Kanye West klarer ikke å forstå poenget.

programme.title: South Park: Tiss
programme.desc: Høyt urininnhold i svømmebassenget fører til en katastrofe som ødelegger guttas dag, særlig Kyles. Og Cartmans xenofobi får fritt utløp igjen.

programme.title: South Park: Broadway-brødrene
programme.desc: Når Randy forstår hemmeligheten bak musikaler, kan han ikke slutte med å ta med seg Sharon for å se dem. Andrew Lloyd-Webber og Elton John advarer ham mot å avsløre deres hemmelighet.

programme.title: South Park: Butter slår tilbake
programme.desc: Butters blir i hemmelighet plaget av sin bestemor og Stan ønsker å øke bevisstheten om farene ved mobbing. Stans idé er å spille inn en stor dansevideo, men suksessen raskt går til hodet på ham.

programme.title: South Park: Glutenfri ebola
programme.desc: South Park blir glutenfritt.

programme.title: South Park: Pre-CIS
programme.desc: Ifølge Eric Cartman har Wendy Testaburger blitt lesbisk.

programme.title: South Park: Du yelper ikke til
programme.desc: Cartman ser seg som den beste restaurantkritikeren på nettet i South Park.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nesten tjue år etter at kult-serien Galaxy Quest ble kansellert, ber romvesener besetningen om hjelp til å redde universet.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: I 2009 oppdaget NASA muligheten for fremmed liv innenfor vårt solsystem. En sonde ble skutt opp for å samle inn prøver fra en av Jupiters måner, Europa, men krasjet på tilbaketuren over Mellom-Amerika.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Den dyktige advokaten Casey McKay blir hentet ut til en liten by av sin ekskone for å forsvare broren, anklaget for å ha drept en lovmann. Han oppdager et nett av intriger der han ender ansikt til ansikt med byens mest korrupte entreprenør, Mr. Gates.

programme.title: Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Da Terry Wolfmeyers (Joan Allen) mann plutselig en dag forlater henne og deres fire døtre uten så mye som et ord til farvel, snus tilværelsen for den vellykkede forstadsfamilien fullstendig på hodet!

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy er et superpopulært nyhetsanker i 1970-årenes San Diego som mener at kvinner kan pynte opp et nyhetsrom. Så når Ron får vite han skal jobbe med en smart, vakker ung dame som mestrer mer enn å være til pynt, blir det krig!

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Eks-agenten Bryan Mills er forsont med sin tidligere kone, men lykken blir kortvarig når hun brutalt myrdes og han blir beskyldt for udåden.

programme.title: Wagons East
programme.desc: De var ute etter gull, men nå tar de til takke med innlagt vann. John Candy og Richard Lewis spiller i dette hysterisk ukonvensjonelle blikket på den legendariske ville vesten.

programme.title: Frøkens Kjæledegge
programme.desc: Clark Gable plays Jim Gannon, a school-of-hard-knocks newspaperman who despises journalism schools, until he sees who's doing the teaching.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: Mens Sydney holder foredrag om indianerne som møtte en mystisk katastrofe 600 år tidligere, gir en innfødt henne en relikvie fra den tiden. Hva er hemmeligheten?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Hunting with the Enemy
programme.desc: En urn bestilt i et kambodsjansk kloster av den kinesiske keiseren for restene av Confucius er i ferd med å bli ødelagt av den systematiske bombingen av en hel provins.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Under the Ice
programme.desc: Til tross for forferdelig vær, drar Sidney Nigel med til en arktisk base hvor en gammel indisk mamma er funnet, som viser seg å være en Anasazi.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel reiser til Istanbul for å undersøke dødsfallet til en av Sydneys venner, en professor som prøvde å bevise at Hercules eksisterte ved å finne Hippolytebeltet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himmelhvelvet
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer som tilsier ham til en planet med 'ild og is'.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: South Park: Regnskog sjmegnskog

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himmelen

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning

programme.desc: Kyle trenger nyretransplantasjon og Cartman er den perfekte donor, men setter en høy pris for nyren: 10 millioner dollar.

programme.desc: Stan vil finne opprinnelsen til malte påskeegg og oppdager en hemmelighet om den katolske kirken.

programme.title: South Park: Døden

programme.desc: Guttene hjelper tidligere visepresident Al Gore i jakten på oppmerksomhet og blir innesperret i en hule. Cartman prøver å finne veien ut og oppdager en skatt.

programme.title: South Park: Buddha Box
programme.desc: Cartman har fått en angstdiagnose.

programme.desc: Cartman anser Token for å være en trussel mot hele menneskeheten.

programme.title: A Haunted House

programme.title: Tully

programme.title: Official Secrets

programme.title: Red Dawn

programme.title: South Park: Barneskolemusikal

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: South Park: Anabola aber
programme.desc: Det är dags för Special Olympics i South Park. Cartman måste övertyga kvalificeringskommittén om att han är handikappad så att han kan slå Jimmy i det kommande evenemanget.

programme.title: South Park: Buddha Box
programme.desc: Cartman får diagnosen att han lider av ångest.

programme.title: South Park: Tonsilltrubbel
programme.desc: En klantigt utförd blodöverföring leder till att Cartman får AIDS. Hur långt kan han tänka sig att gå för att hitta ett botemedel?

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans dumma hatbrott 2000
programme.desc: FBI börjar undersöka Cartmans hatbrott efter att han kastar en sten på Token.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans otroliga present
programme.desc: Ett misslyckat flygförsök leder till att Cartman hamnar på sjukhuset. Polisen tror honom när han säger att han har brottslösande övernaturliga krafter och anlitar honom för att hjälpa dem att fånga en seriemördare.

programme.title: South Park: Att höja ribban
programme.desc: Cartman erkänner äntligen att han är fet och får omedelbart en permobil.

programme.title: South Park: Rödhåriga ungar
programme.desc: Cartman lider av 'Gingervitus' och går till kamp mot förföljelsen av rödhåriga.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmanland
programme.desc: Cartman ärver en miljon dollar från sin mormor och kan därmed köpa det han alltid önskat sig: sin egen nöjespark - Cartmanland!

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet I
programme.desc: Pojkarna hamnar i ett magiskt land där de får chansen att köpa hela världens fantasi. Men en terroristkomplott hotar att förstöra affären.

programme.title: South Park: Valhoror
programme.desc: Stan försöker att stoppa japanerna från att döda alla valar och delfiner i världen.

programme.title: South Park: Crackbabyförbundet
programme.desc: När Kyle upptäcker att Cartman arbetar frivilligt med crackbebisar på sjukhuset blir han misstänksam. Och vad har Slash från Guns N' Roses med detta att göra?

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med tvåan i pissoaren
programme.desc: Cartman tror att han vet vem som var hjärnan bakom 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman hittar kärleken
programme.desc: Det flyttar in en ny flicka i South Park, och Cartman försöker att para ihop henne med en kille.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman och Kyle blir osams om en magisk triangel de hittar under en arkeologisk utgrävning. Triangeln har kraften att omvandla Barbra Streisand till ett otäckt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Du Yelper inte
programme.desc: Cartman anser sig vara South Parks viktigaste matkritiker på nätet.

programme.title: South Park: #Omtugg
programme.desc: Kyle vill spela tv-spel med sin lilllebror, men Ike vill inte längre spela med honom, så Kyle blir rädd för att nästa generation håller på att köra om honom.

programme.title: South Park: När det träffar fläkten
programme.desc: Det blir uppror i South Park när invånarna hör ordet '****' i det populära programmet 'Cop Drama'.

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Stan skaffar en Okama Gamesphere och pojkarna fascineras av den. Medan de spelar kommer en pratande handduk som heter Towelie och pratar med dem.

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos
programme.desc: Killarna avskedar Butters från att vara deras vän, vilket framkallar hans mörka sida.

programme.title: South Park: Kidnappning är inte kul
programme.desc: Efter att ha tittat på för mycket TV är Tweek övertygad om att barn lever farligt och att han kommer att bli kidnappad.

programme.title: South Park: Grå gryning
programme.desc: Pensionärer tvingas lämna in sina körkort efter att de orsakat kaos på gatorna. Stans farfar anlitar AARP för att hjälpa pensionärerna att få dem tillbaka.

programme.title: South Park: Geggfolk
programme.desc: South Park översvämmas av arbetare från framtiden som tar alla jobben för lägre löner. Männen i South Park går förvånansvärt långt för att stoppa dem.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: När Wall-Mart omvandlar South Park till en spökstad försöker Stan och Kyle förstöra affären, men en besatt Cartman ställer sig i vägen.

programme.title: South Park: Bästisar för alltid
programme.desc: Cartman blir avundsjuk när Kenny får den sista spelkonsolen innan den är slut på affären. Kommer Cartman och Kenny att kunna fortsätta vara bästa vänner för all framtid?

programme.title: South Park: Mer skitproblem
programme.desc: Randy bryter rekordet för 'världens största bajskorv'. Bono, den förra rekordhållaren, är fast besluten att återta sin krona. Men han har en mörk hemlighet som kan stoppa honom.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Stan och Kyle är beredda att ta sig upp i världen med sina färdigheter i datorspelet Guitar Hero. Deras manager övertygar Stan att Kyle håller honom tillbaka vilket orsakar spänning.

programme.title: South Park: Hög skolmusikal!
programme.desc: När den sjungande, dansande musikalfebern kommer till South Park måste pojkarna spela med eller ge upp sin popularitet.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med sin nya tjej på en konsert med Jonas Brothers där de köper var sin kyskhetsring.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskpittar
programme.desc: Cartman och Jimmy kommer på det roligaste skämtet någonsin.

programme.title: South Park: Kiss
programme.desc: En rolig dag i vattenparken blir plötsligt livshotande.

programme.title: South Park: Broadwaybröderna
programme.desc: När Randy får veta hemligheten om varför musikaler är så populära kan han inte sluta att ta med Sharon för att se dem. Andrew Lloyd-Webber och Elton John varnar honom för att avslöja deras hemlighet.

programme.title: South Park: Butters ger igen
programme.desc: Butters mobbas i hemlighet av sin farmor och Stan försöker att uppmärksamma folk om faran med mobbning. Han gör en dansvideo, men framgången stiger honom åt huvudet. Stan misslyckas och åker till San Diego för att näcka i ett gathörn.

programme.title: A Midsummer's Hawaiian Dream
programme.desc: I denna parafras på Shakespeares “En midsommarnattsdröm” försöker två gifta antropologprofessorer och deras studenter hitta en helig tiki för att stoppa skövlingen av Hawaiis djungel.

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: In 1959, Truman Capote, learns about the horrific and senseless murder of a family of four in Kansas. As he digs deeper into the story, he is inspired to expand the project into what would be his greatest work, In Cold Blood.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1990s, one criminal terrorized an entire community. Witnesses refused to speak out. They knew the consequences could be deadly.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the streets of New York flooded with crack cocaine in the 1980's a wave of violence threatened to drown the city. Colombian cartels brought the coke in and ran their operations with an iron fist.

programme.title: The Good Heart
programme.desc: Jaques (Brian Cox – THE BOURNE IDENTITY) äger en sjaskig bar, som fungerar som ett andra hem för en brokig skara professionella drinkare. Jaques själv är fast besluten att supa och röka sig till döds. När han möter den unge hemlöse Lucas…

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: Den tidigare TV-chefen från New York, Joanna Eberhart flyttar med familjen till samhället Stepford, Connecticut, men börjar förstå att Stepford är aningen för perfekt.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: När en amerikansk stad invaderas av nordkoreanska soldater, går en grupp ungdomar tillsammans för att skydda varandra, befria staden och återta sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensionerade CIA-agenten Bryan Mills och hans fru är i Istanbul när de blir kidnappade. Mannen som håller dom som gisslan visar sig vara far till en av de män som tidigare kidnappat Mills dotter, och som han under fritagandet av dottern dödat.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson är tillbaka som Bryan Mills. Men denna gång är det han själv som hamnar i knipa då han blir jagad för ett mord han inte begått.

programme.title: Mclintock! (Producer'S Cut)
programme.desc: The Duke stars as George Washington McLintock, a defiant cattle baron whose daughter Becky is due home from college. But G.W.'s reunion with his daughter is tempered by the arrival of his wife Katherine, who left him two years earlier.

programme.title: Cary Grant - En gentleman i London
programme.desc: Komedi omen miljonärsson och playboy

programme.title: Andromeda: Dess timme har äntligen kommit
programme.desc: Ett gammalt minne från Andromeda aktiveras av misstag, vilket skickar henne på ett uppdrag och gör att Dylan och besättningen inte kan åsidosätta kommandot.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den växande strömmen
programme.desc: Dylan och Rommie måste rädda Tyr, Harper och Rev från Magogs världsskepp.

programme.title: Andromeda: Utgång strategier
programme.desc: Dylan, Beka, Rev och Tyr kraschlandar efter att ha undkommit ett gäng Nietzscheaner men ställs snart inför ett nytt hot: Revs behov för matning.

programme.title: Mutant X: Antagen skuldig
programme.desc: Adam blir anklagad för mord av en ny mutant med förmågan att stjäla människors minnen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.desc: One of Tennessee''s most respected thoroughbred horse farms, the Rose Mont was built by Judge "Jo" Conn Guild, where his family resided for generations. Today, it operates as a wedding and event venue where guests have claimed to spot apparitions.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Tennessee's first maximum security prison was a glorified slave labor camp that treated inmates as single use units of labor. Miners were left to die during cave-ins, and the facility was known as "the end of the line."

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Owned and operated by the same caretakers of Old South Pittsburg Hospital, Harriman presents a unique opportunity for the team to delve further into the study of hospital phenomena.

programme.desc: Cartman anser sig vara South Parks viktigaste matkritiker på nätet.

programme.desc: Flera älskade underhållare går ur tiden efter att ha överdoserat på opiater, och Stan är på vippen att avslöjas som källan till dessa olagliga droger.

programme.desc: När Chef misslyckas med att sälja sin kola vid en besökande filmfestival ändrar han sitt recept till salta chokladbollar och skriver en sång som ska hjälpa till att sälja dem.

programme.desc: Chef försöker göra anspråk på royalties från ett skivbolag när de släpper en låt som han påstår att han skrev för 20 år sedan.

programme.title: Tully

programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: How to Be
programme.desc: Art (Robert Pattinson) blir dumpad av flickvännen och flyttar tillbaka hem till mamma och pappa och hamnar i en 25-årskris. Art lägger sitt arv på inköp och new age-terapi och tar så småningom även hjälp av en excentrisk själv-hjälps-guru, Dr Ellington.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en mycket framgångsrik försäljare stressar över att landa en stor affär. Till sin hjälp måste hon samarbeta med Jonathan som är fullt upptagen med att skapa en magisk jul till sin flickvän. Konflikten är given, men något annat börjar också gry...

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: Emma sitter på ett plan som hon tror är på väg att störta. Hon berättar därför alla sina hemligheter för en snygg främling. Åtminstone tror hon att han är en främling...tills hon träffar Jack, hennes företags nya vd. Baserad på romanen med samma namn.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Pratglade agenten Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) har siktat in sig på New Age-gurun dr Sinja. Men när ett mystiskt Bodhi-träd dyker upp i hans trädgård, inser Jack att det är bäst att han skärper sig innan det sista lövet faller från trädet.

programme.title: TAKEN
programme.desc: Bryan, en före detta CIA-agent har svårt att släppa sin gamla yrkesroll och ser faror överallt. När hans dotter, Kim, åker till Paris, besannas hans värsta mardröm, hon kidnappas.

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: För att lindra sina ekonomiska problem söker en anställd på en resebyrå efter ett fruset lik, som råkar vara eftertraktat av två mördare.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin

programme.title: That Touch Of Mink

programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

This super shocker of the century was a smash hit upon its 1959 release. For architecture buffs, the home used for the exteriors of the haunted house was actually designed by Frank Lloyd Wright and built in 1924!

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead (In Color & Restored) (Edited Version)
programme.desc: This is one of the true cult classics and one of the scariest movies of all time. The dead are walking and hunger for human flesh. A group of panicked survivors are barricaded in a deserted farmhouse while the army of flesh eating zombies hovers outside their door. This over-the-top disk includes a restored original black and white version, and a color version that will thrill the horror film fan and horrify the film purist. We've added a 5.1 surround sound mix, and bonus features including a hilarious audio commentary by Mike Nelson of Mystery Science Theater 3000.

As they pick up vibrations they have visions of how the person died. Each vibration and vision seems to get darker and darker. In the midst of all of this, they are being stalked by a dark shadowy figure. What starts out as some Halloween fun quickly turns to terror...

programme.title: Rise of the Mummy

programme.title: My Bloody Birthday
programme.desc: After a terrible trauma on her birthday, Emma chooses not to celebrate it again. But when she turns 21, a friend of her breaks the ritual with a surprise party, unaware of awakening horrors, which for years have been waiting in the darkness...

programme.title: Slasher.com

Her peaceful life completely changes when the young girl rents a room that was once owned by Lien the daughter of the landlord, who was kidnapped, raped and killed by five criminals, who were never caught...

programme.title: The Devil's Fairground
programme.desc: Starring Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson and John Charles Dickson. The Stars of two competing and colliding paranormal television shows converge on an abandoned haunted amusement park which ends up being the epicenter to hell. They are now all trapped - in an all out war against pure evil...

programme.title: Whisper
programme.desc: A young Nurse is assigned to look after a patient in a remote location in the English countryside. As the night continues she finds herself terrorized by an unseen force that is connected with her patient...

programme.title: Ouija Hosts
programme.desc: Presenters of paranormal TV show "Ghost Hosts" are filming in an abandoned haunted building as part of a Halloween special. The stories surrounding the horrifying ghosts of the mansion are about to become reality...

programme.title: The Devil's Forest
programme.desc: Rachel and her team of film makers travel to Transylvania, Romania, to document the paranormal phenomena within Hoia-Baciu Forest...

programme.title: Ghost Boat
programme.desc: Trapped aboard the family yacht, Samantha lives out her personal Hell, night after night, answering to the cruel and painful demands of the ship's alarm system. Taking a journey into the depths of depravity, she wakes each morning to the disfiguring scars left by the previous night's horror and searches for the answer to a missing memory: 'Could I have killed my family... Or did Hell get it wrong?

programme.title: H.P. Lovecraft's Monster Portal

programme.title: Remember Me

programme.title: Island of the Dolls
programme.desc: A group of people go to the legendary Island of the Dolls to learn the deadly truth...

programme.title: Derelict

programme.title: The Cult of Humpty Dumpty
programme.desc: A group of troubled teen girls and their teacher must fight for survival after discovering a cult has brought Humpty Dumpty, a killer doll, back to life and set loose on the camp where they are staying...

programme.title: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When a psychiatric doctor researches a young girls' diary to find out why she murdered her entire family, he begins to fall into the same state of insomnia and confusion that led her to lose her mind...

programme.title: Doctor Carver

programme.title: The Demon's Child

programme.title: Goatman

programme.title: Demonic Plastic Surgeon, MD

programme.title: Python Island
programme.desc: A group of people searching for a magical tree in a mysterious jungle, find they are not alone. Something is watching them, waiting for the perfect moment to strike...

programme.title: Ouija Deadly Reunion

programme.title: Dead End Demon (aka Dead End 2)

programme.title: Dinosaur Hotel 2
programme.desc: Surviving contestants are reunited in the ultimate game to win 10 million dollars. Only one contestant will survive and claim the prize as the others fall to the dinosaurs...

programme.title: The Leprechaun's Game
programme.desc: After a bunch of thieves are sent out to hunt for urban legends by a wealthy man intending to open a museum full of mythical creatures. Soon, the thieves will learn the legend of a Leprechaun...

programme.title: The Body Tree
programme.desc: When a group of Americans travels to Russian Siberia to honor the memory of their murdered friend, they uncover a plot that threatens all their lives...

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 10 - Final Stand
programme.desc: The All-Stars deploy on an executive-protection mission for a key negotiator as escalating terrorist activity turns the operation into a fight to secure their principal and survive.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 1 - Skinny Dip in a Snowstorm
programme.desc: Surviving Mann returns with its most punishing season opener yet. In true Don Mann fashion, the bar is raised with a grueling 10-part physical readiness test—infused with a blast of hypothermia for good measure. Don himself calls it “the most brutal PT [he’s] ever witnessed,” and it’s clear the contestants are in for a world of hurt. To push them even further, MMA legend Ken Shamrock joins the fray, bringing his no-nonsense intensity to whip the group into fighting shape. Those who survive the trial by ice and exertion are rewarded with a chance to test-fire the lightest AR on the market—if they can still feel their trigger fingers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 2 - Welcome to the Lion’s Den
programme.desc: For the first time in Surviving Mann history, the contestants undergo intense combat training led by none other than Ken Shamrock—"the most dangerous man in the world." His relentless situation drills push this elite group beyond their limits, sharpening their instincts and forging next-level tactical readiness. As a new mission begins to take shape, the pressure mounts—and the team learns that the strongest among them will earn a game-changing reward. But in a world where every edge matters, not everyone is built to keep up. Fatigue sets in, tensions rise, and the difference between teammate and competitor begins to blur. With Shamrock watching closely, only the most disciplined will rise to meet the challenge—and prove they’re worthy of what lies ahead.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 3 - Welcome the Pain
programme.desc: Back by unpopular demand, the infamous “Blah Line” returns—and it’s more brutal than ever. The contestants kick off the day with a hellish PT session that leaves bodies broken and spirits tested. Things only get rougher from there with a punishing stealth crawl over jagged rocks, grinding them down before they face Ken Shamrock’s infamous Lion’s Den training—a relentless gauntlet of pain, grit, and raw endurance. As Don Mann continues to forge a battle-ready team, the squad is thrown into breaching drills designed for high-stakes mission execution. It’s chaos, it’s calculated, and it separates the contenders from the pretenders. In the heat of the action, two standouts emerge from the ranks—earning the coveted role of designated breachers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 4 - Trigger Points
programme.desc: The day begins with a powerful dose of perspective as contestants hear real-life breaching stories from American heroes—reminders of the stakes they’re preparing for. The team is then introduced to a concealed firearm headrest safe designed for rapid-response vehicle defense. Next, it’s straight into the action with a preliminary course of fire using GreenLight sights, where top performers are pushed even further with a bonus round to test speed, accuracy, and composure under pressure. The intensity ramps up during a sentry scenario featuring SABRE CO₂ non-lethal cartridges, putting their stealth and judgment to the test. But just as the dust begins to settle, a new CIA briefing drops—and it’s the most dire yet. With mission reality closing in fast, the contestants close the day with a crash course in S.E.R.E. (Survival, Evasion, Resistance, and Escape) training, rounding out their classroom combat readiness with hard-earned grit.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 5 - No Armor, No Mercy
programme.desc: The stakes continue to climb as Green Light Sights rewards one top shooter with their very own custom weapon—proof that precision pays off. But there's no time to celebrate. Bear Arms ups the ante by issuing defense vests to every contestant, with one hard rule: once it’s on, it stays on. From grueling mission briefings to body armor plank challenges that push endurance to the brink, the weight—literally and mentally—never lets up. Still armored, the team reports to Ken Shamrock for another brutal dose of Lion’s Den physical punishment. Just when they think they’ve caught a break, Compliant Technologies’ infamous glove makes a shocking return to torment a fresh round of contestants. And as the day winds down, Don introduces the team to his personal “Flights” challenge—an unforgiving test no one is excited to take on. It all ends with a sobering CIA reminder: in the field, your backstory might just save your life—or end it.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 6 - The Complete Warrior
programme.desc: This week, memory meets mission as contestants face off in a high-stakes Kim’s Game challenge—designed to sharpen recall under pressure with 100 points and team leadership on the line. With observation, speed, and accuracy all in play, remembering every detail could make or break the mission. As the team pushes forward, it’s time to dig deeper. Contestants open up about their backstories, revealing the powerful personal reasons that brought them to the toughest reality show on earth. Some are here to prove something. Others? To fight for more than just themselves. The action intensifies as Hoffner Knives returns with a brutal tactical evolution, testing shooting and blade skills with precision under pressure. A split-second difference determines the winner of a major reward—proving that in this game, every tenth of a second matters. The day wraps with a visit from HCA Precision Barrels and one final classroom lesson—a pointed reminder that in the world of elite operators, your story is your strength… or your downfall.

programme.title: Beyond The Close 1 Ep. 1 - Tough Times Don't Last, Tough People Do
programme.desc: Ten of the country’s top realtors enter a career-defining competition, guided by an all-star team of business experts as they battle to prove who has what it takes to become number one.

programme.title: Boom America - The Kick-Off Meeting
programme.desc: Kevin Harrington and his A-Team meet Nuethix and Stream2Sea, digging into the growth challenges holding each company back and mapping out their next moves.

programme.title: Boom America S1 Ep. 2 - The A-Team Don’t Pull Punches
programme.desc: Kevin Harrington’s A-Team puts Nuethix, Dr. Price Vitamins, Stream2Sea and Clear Water through a candid strategy session while revealing the expertise behind the team.

programme.title: Kicking Off With A Jolt
programme.desc: The first episode of The Big Reveal kicks off with a bang or rather, a jolt, as Compliant Technologies premieres their newest gadget for pioneering the safety of police officers and civilians alike. Next, Kevin Harrington meets with two individuals that Unlock Math for children around the world. Later, Sheriff Mark Lamb sits down with Bonnie from Off Duty Police Officers for a look at her streamlining systems.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 2 - Three Entrepreneurs Walk Into a Bar...
programme.desc: The Big Reveal does it again by bringing three very different entrepreneurs together, all connected by their pioneer spirit. Flag Guard tips off this episode by explaining how they’re doing their part in keeping your loved ones safe. After that, Dr. West explains how his revolutionary probiotic will fix your digestive health 100% of the time. Host Kevin Harrington then caps off this episode in style with a trip to Tommasina Eyewear’s studio with a peak behind the curtain.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 1 - Liberty Locked & Loaded
programme.desc: Host Tim Harmsen kicks off Wild Shots with a coast-to-coast deep dive into American gun culture. From the first colonial settlement to Capitol Hill, he explores the origins of the Second Amendment and the modern fight to protect it. Along the way, he teams up with top firearms experts and puts iconic weapons to the test—including a brutal challenge to see just how many rounds it takes to break an AR-15.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 2 - 10,000 Rounds, No Mercy
programme.desc: Host Tim Harmsen teams up with SEAL Team 6 legend Don Mann to tackle real-world defense tactics and home-clearing techniques. A visit to Civil War battlefields connects history to modern freedoms, while the brutal 5-Year AR Challenge pushes an AR-15 through 10,000 rounds without cleaning. Will the rifle survive—or fail under fire?

programme.title: We’re Back in Gorge-ous Colorado
programme.desc: Ziplining in Colorado’s Gorges, free falls and donuts. The Real Man show is back in full swing in Colorado. Kyle is joined by special guests and American Patriots as he explores what thrills and adventures this amazing country has to offer. And he’s just getting started.

programme.title: We’re off to a Rocky Start
programme.desc: In the last episode, Kyle took to the skies; now it’s the seas. Co-host Josh Peterson joins Kyle on a deep sea fishing excursion that ends in one of them losing their lunch.. but who will it be? Later (after everyone’s cleaned up) the gang reconvenes for a legendary course of fire with some serious artillery… and Bob.

programme.title: Fortress 1 Ep. 1 - Homesteads and Handguns
programme.desc: In the premiere of Fortress, Sheriff Mark Lamb and co-hosts explore America’s urgent need for security—both personal and societal. They meet a passionate team turning donated land into a homestead that feeds and shelters trafficking survivors. Then, CCW Safe steps in to showcase how legal protection for concealed carriers can be the line between justice and ruin. Powerful stories of resilience, protection, and purpose unfold in this compelling first episode.

programme.title: Farm Hero 1 Ep. 1 - It’s Not the Cow, It’s the How
programme.desc: Laura Zaspel visits Parker Pastures in Colorado, where Bill Parker and his daughters use grass-fed livestock and holistic practices to fight desertification and rethink farm-to-table.

programme.title: From the Dust Bowl To Cover Crops
programme.desc: At an Iowa farm with deep Dust Bowl roots, Elizabeth Garst champions cover crops and soil health as erosion threatens the region’s future.

programme.title: Farm Hero 1 Ep. 3 - From Farm to City Table
programme.desc: Laura visits the Killpatrick family, whose backyard farm grew from a pandemic project into a thriving community hub for regenerative, holistic and organic food.
